design_consequences: Use three explorer lanes: current technical capability; rights, consent, privacy, and commercial terms; and production workflow plus a falsifiable blind-audition protocol tied to the exact 12:30 package.
Seed a broad but bounded official-source landscape, then recommend at most three audition candidates rather than declaring a voice-quality winner from desk research.
Keep capability fit, production fit, voice quality, cost, commercial rights, privacy, and cloning consent as separate dimensions with explicit unknowns and hard gates.
Require exact official URLs, page titles, source-local headings or structured selectors, retrieval dates, and observed/unverified status for every load-bearing comparison row.
Treat price estimates as time-scoped arithmetic with stated assumptions; do not normalize incomparable plans or infer missing usage terms.
Require the final findings to include a fixed audition excerpt, generation settings, blind-listening rubric, caption-alignment check, and stop conditions for unsafe or undocumented providers.
